# Schema `public`

standard public schema

## `public.schema_migrations`

One row per SQL migration applied by the runner in packages/db. Forward-only: rows are never removed.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | References | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | text | no |  |  | Four-digit prefix of the migration file name; files apply in this order. |
| `name` | text | no |  |  | Rest of the migration file name, without the .sql extension. |
| `checksum` | text | no |  |  | SHA-256 of the file when applied. A different checksum later means an applied migration was edited, which the runner refuses. |
| `applied_at` | timestamp with time zone | no | `now()` |  | When the migration was applied (UTC). |
